mediaServicesRecovery.trigger: Injected mediaServicesWereLostNotification / mediaServicesWereResetNotification, not an actual OS media-server restart.
mediaServicesRecovery.implementation: Loss invalidates the current request. Reset invalidates before rebuilding AVSpeechSynthesizer; old delegate is removed. Session category/mode/options are reapplied on the next explicit start. Reset never activates audio or speaks.
mediaServicesRecovery.deterministic: Loss and reset, including reset during pending activation and reset without preceding loss, invalidate tokens and ignore late callbacks/resumption recommendations.
mediaServicesRecovery.realAdapter: Factory observed two distinct real AVSpeechSynthesizer objects, detached old delegate and configured new delegate/session ownership. A 750 ms idle window submitted no speech; explicit solo-turn retry received real started/finished callbacks.
